timid: Over the years I have learnt to manage my timidity, though it has never entirely gone away.

timid.es: Con los años he aprendido a gestionar mi timidez, aunque nunca ha desaparecido del todo.

headstrong: He gives the impression of being rather headstrong.

headstrong.es: Da la impresión de ser bastante testarudo.

withdrawn.es: El candidato seguro de sí mismo y hablador nos parece competente; el callado parece retraído, quizá incluso hostil.

candid.es: Probablemente consiga el trabajo. Es la mejor candidata.

perceptive: She struck me as very perceptive.
But I have also noticed that the quiet people in a room are often the most perceptive.

perceptive.es: Pero también me he dado cuenta de que las personas calladas de una sala suelen ser las más perspicaces.

self-conscious: Our new colleague seemed rather self-conscious at first.

self-conscious.es: Nuestra nueva compañera parecía bastante cohibida al principio.

wary: I am still wary of large parties and still prefer one long conversation to twenty short ones.

wary.es: Sigo recelando de las fiestas multitudinarias y sigo prefiriendo una conversación larga a veinte cortas.

wary: Having been warned twice, he had no excuse.

notwithstanding.es: A pesar de estos retos, los beneficios aumentaron.

remotely.es: Con la condición de poder trabajar a distancia, diría que sí.

likelihood: The likelihood of rain tomorrow is low.

likelihood.es: La probabilidad de lluvia mañana es baja.

likelihood: There's little likelihood of them winning the match.

refurbish: We're having the kitchen refurbished next month.

refurbish.es: Nos van a reformar la cocina el mes que viene.

refurbishment: Two years on, the refurbishment is finally finished.

refurbishment.es: Dos años después, la reforma por fin está terminada.

refurbishment: The refurbishment is expected to take approximately eight months.

live up to.es: El hotel no estuvo a la altura de las fotos de su web.

brush up on: I need to brush up on my French before the trip.

play down: I know this has been a frustrating setback, and I won't play down how much extra work it means.

implementation: The implementation of the new policy has been delayed.

reluctance: Her reluctance to accept the offer surprised everyone.

arguably: She is arguably the best player of her generation.

arguably.es: Se podría decir que es la mejor jugadora de su generación.

nuance.es: Se podría decir que los lectores tienen parte de culpa: hacemos clic en la certeza, no en los matices.

substitution: Good writers avoid repeating themselves by using substitution and ellipsis.

substitution.es: Los buenos escritores evitan repetirse mediante la sustitución y la elipsis.

ellipsis: Good writers avoid repeating themselves by using substitution and ellipsis.

outnumber: In our team, women outnumber men by three to one.

heighten: The scandal has heightened tension between the two parties.

heighten.es: El escándalo ha intensificado la tensión entre los dos partidos.

sharpen.es: Entender cómo se forman las palabras no solo ampliará tu vocabulario, sino que también agudizará tu comprensión lectora.

understandably: Understandably, she was very upset about it.

understandably.es: Comprensiblemente, estaba muy disgustada por ello.

understandably: Understandably, the owners are proud of their wine list.

predictably: Predictably, the first few minutes are uncomfortable.

interestingly: Interestingly, clients often ask for him by name.

acre: He comes across as arrogant, but he's actually very shy.

acre.es: Parece arrogante, pero en realidad es muy tímido.

acre: Horses, bulls and deer, painted in red, black and yellow, seemed to run across the rock.

batter: The Z5 is cheaper and its battery lasts longer.

batter.es: El Z5 es más barato y su batería dura más.

blister.es: El otro camino siempre parece más verde porque nunca tuviste que recorrerlo, con sus ampollas y sus tormentas.

cite.es: En 2050, las ciudades serán más grandes.

confide: Children who read are a bit more confident at school.

confide: Jim, who had been so confident at breakfast, went very quiet.

constraint: Be that as it may, budget constraints remain.

crumb: Only a few crumbs were left on the plate.

crumb.es: Solo quedaban unas migas en el plato.

cynic: He's too cynical to believe in that.

descent: That said, the descent can be slippery.

descent.es: Dicho esto, el descenso puede ser resbaladizo.

devotee: Until then, I remain your most devoted servant.

devotee.es: Hasta entonces, quedo como tu más devoto servidor.

enormously: Travelling has changed enormously in the last fifty years.

enormously.es: Viajar ha cambiado muchísimo en los últimos cincuenta años.

enormously: Any comments, however brief, would be enormously appreciated.

enormously.es: Cualquier comentario, por breve que sea, se lo agradecería enormemente.

expire: She did recover, slowly, but by then the offer had expired and I had met Tom.

expire.es: Se recuperó, poco a poco, pero para entonces la oferta había caducado y yo había conocido a Tom.

fiercely: She's fiercely independent and hates asking for help.

fuse: I am not, by nature, a person who makes a fuss.

fuse.es: Yo no soy, por naturaleza, de las que montan escándalos.

homely: She also volunteers at a charity which gives food to homeless people.

homely.es: Además, es voluntaria en una organización benéfica que da comida a personas sin hogar.

hostile: The confident, talkative candidate strikes us as competent; the quiet one seems withdrawn, perhaps even hostile.

inheritance: He frittered away his inheritance in two years.

inheritance.es: Despilfarró su herencia en dos años.

injustice: You may be irritated by a slow queue, furious at an injustice, and incandescent with rage at a betrayal.

injustice.es: Puede que te irrite una cola lenta, que te enfurezca una injusticia y que estalles de rabia ante una traición.

isolate.es: Además, los estudiantes pueden sentirse aislados.

isolated.es: Además, los estudiantes pueden sentirse aislados.

numb.es: Recepcionista: ¿Cuál es su número de teléfono?

offspring: Kids, children and offspring refer to the same people, but in very different contexts.

plummet.es: Las ventas se desplomaron en enero.

plummet: Prices soar and plummet, markets panic and recover, inflation bites, currencies tumble and economies overheat.

plummet.es: Los precios se disparan y se desploman, los mercados entran en pánico y se recuperan, la inflación muerde, las monedas se hunden y las economías se recalientan.

profess: Dear Professor Hughes, I hope you'll forgive the intrusion.

profess.es: Estimado profesor Hughes: espero que me disculpe la intromisión.

prop: It's about time you found a proper job.

prop.es: Ya va siendo hora de que encuentres un trabajo de verdad.

quest: That's a question with no correct answer.

quest.es: Esa pregunta no tiene respuesta correcta.

quest: We asked our readers a simple question: what would you do if you won ten million euros?

quest.es: Hicimos a nuestros lectores una pregunta sencilla: ¿qué haríais si os tocaran diez millones de euros?

recess: A recession described as a "storm" sounds like nobody's responsibility; one described as "self-inflicted" sounds like a scandal.

recess.es: Una recesión descrita como una «tormenta» parece no ser responsabilidad de nadie; una descrita como «autoinfligida» suena a escándalo.

reluctantly: He reluctantly conceded that he had been wrong.

reluctantly.es: Admitió a regañadientes que se había equivocado.

robust.es: La autora principal sostiene que los datos son sólidos.

sentimental: The critics dismissed the novel as sentimental rubbish.

snail.es: En Francia tomé caracoles con mantequilla de ajo.

spacious.es: Nuestra habitación estaba impecablemente limpia y era sorprendentemente amplia.

stray: Tom: I've never eaten anything strange!

stray: Have you ever eaten anything really strange?

suffice: Suffice it to say, I won't be eating there again.

suffice.es: Baste decir que no volveré a comer allí.

tantamount.es: Su negativa equivalía a una dimisión.

tantamount: It is tantamount to removing a small public space where strangers still talk to each other.

trying: Keep trying new things, even small ones!

verdict: The verdict delivered, the courtroom fell silent.
